title: Index fictional civil-rights record relationships

parent.objective: Demonstrate traceable record organization for a wholly fictional North Carolina civil-rights workspace.

goal: Index two synthetic original records and their declared derived notes while preserving explicit source links.
non_goals: Assess liability, constitutional claims, jurisdiction, or limitation periods.
Identify real defendants or contact any person or institution.

allowed: Create an index from the embedded fictional source and note descriptors.
Check declared links, identifier uniqueness, and complete record coverage.
prohibited: Assert legal authority or add real case facts.
Change originals, infer undeclared relationships, or publish records.

inputs.name: Synthetic source manifest
inputs.description: CR-SYN-001: fictional location sketch; CR-SYN-002: fictional observation log.

inputs.name: Synthetic derived-note manifest
inputs.description: CR-NOTE-001 cites CR-SYN-001; CR-NOTE-002 cites CR-SYN-002. Both notes and their links are fictional indexing fixtures.

outputs.name: Record relationship index
outputs.description: Four uniquely identified rows separating originals from derived notes, with source links on note rows.

outputs.name: Relationship verification record
outputs.description: Recorded coverage, uniqueness, link-resolution, and unchanged-original-label checks.

interface.name: synthetic_record_relationship_index
interface.description: Input source and derived-note descriptors; output record_id, record_kind, label, and source_ids.

assumptions: The manifests and relationships are fictional and contain no real evidence.
Only explicitly supplied note-to-source relationships may be indexed.

sources.reference: The fictional source and derived-note manifests embedded in this contract inputs.
sources.authority: Synthetic fixture data only; no legal authority, deadline determination, or real-world allegation.

acceptance_criteria.description: All four records appear once and retain their original or derived classification.
Each note has exactly its declared source link, every link resolves, and source labels remain unchanged.

validation.description: Compare indexed identifiers, classifications, labels, and link sets with the embedded manifests.
evidence_required: Source-link resolution and exact-label comparison results.

context_scope: This contract and its embedded fictional manifests.
The derived relationship index and verification record.
architecture_boundaries: Preserve original-record identity and separate derived notes.
Perform indexing checks only; make no legal or factual findings.

domain.jurisdiction_label: North Carolina context label only; no jurisdiction determination.
